instance_description:
Setting: In 2026, a local tabletop miniatures hobby scene in Madison, Wisconsin centers on casual skirmish games, model painting, terrain building, store leagues, and occasional convention events.
Scope: Covers one hobbyist’s recurring miniature-gaming life: painting queues, roster preparation, friendly match planning, terrain upkeep, storage choices, rules-reference notes, swap considerations, and hobby spending.
Resources: Personal records, working notes, and app history provide the background for recurring activities within this scope.
Exclusions: Excludes professional commissions, formal art instruction, gambling, unrelated board-game nights, store management, official tournament administration.
personal_description:
Identity: Theo Marcellus Ivers is a recreational tabletop miniatures painter and skirmish-game player in Madison, Wisconsin, active throughout 2026.
Responsibilities: He maintains his own model collection, plans paint sessions, prepares legal casual rosters, coordinates friendly games, packs supplies, tracks terrain needs, and records hobby purchases.
Authority: Theo may manage his personal hobby records, payments, reminders, project notes, and messages to fellow players, but he cannot set venue policies or publish official rulings.
Restrictions: He avoids handling minors’ personal data, selling painted models as a business, altering store league results, copying copyrighted rulebooks into records, or using these resources for non-hobby life.
